items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Mads directly; the name is introduced by the interviewer who states Alex Hill 'was a friend of Mads.'

ctx.x: He had some, I think he had a white guy on the trombone. I can't remember his name, but he wasn't very warm, I think.
Did you know Alex Hill, by the way? Alex Hill, yeah. He was a piano player and a rancher, he was a friend of Mads. He used to hit it kind of hard. I don't recall that.
A musical director type of man.
